summary: Fresh independent canonical audit after the Mingshi 064 chronology repair. All 133 Chinese units, 24 temporal or active-hint items, and 3 people were reviewed against current hashes. claim-10 correctly retains 明初 as unresolved early-Ming context, while direct 洪武元年十月 evidence in s0029 and its AD 1368 hint remain intact. Remaining chronology is conservatively retained as source-linked research holds. No canonical extraction was edited.
